summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification (public URL, real clicks/typing) after the emerald/Antonio-Saira restyle and AuthShell change. Confirmed: real user interactions DO work (no overlay interception in Playwright) — the visual-edits overlay the main agent hit is specific to its own screenshot browser. Verified /dice initial roll, Roll-again fetching a new suggestion, dice-to-builder navigation + full prefill (A/B/C + conflict + toast), dice-conflict-link navigation, Browse search/category/add-to-builder + badge, admin login with captcha -> /browse, and builder save -> /library (then deleted the test plot).

ui_bugs.issue: COSMETIC: the A-clause line renders a duplicated character badge — the 'A' tag chip followed by ClauseText parsing the leading 'A' of 'A Subtle Person' as a character symbol, so it reads 'A [A] Subtle Person'. Same pattern appears in Builder's selected-a_clause/skeleton preview ('A Married Person -> A Married Person'). Consider not running ClauseText symbol-parsing on the leading article of clause descriptions.

issues: The empty-state illustration is a grey blurred/unrecognisable blob (looks like a broken or wrong-crop image) above 'No saved plots yet.' — replace with a meaningful illustration or an icon.

Centered form works and is readable, but the captcha answer field is a native number input with visible spinner arrows next to a tiny wrapped question box ('What is 5 + 2?' wraps onto 2 lines) — slightly cramped; consider type=text with numeric inputMode and a wider question chip.

action_items: No functional bugs found in the requested flows — dice-to-builder navigates AND prefills correctly (verified clause text match char-for-char and builder-conflict-<id> present).
Optional cosmetic: avoid double 'A' badge rendering on clause descriptions (ClauseText on leading article).
Optional: replace the blurry Library empty-state image.
critical_code_review_comments: Dice.sendToBuilder calls reset() then setField() three times; safe today only because setField uses functional setState — keep it that way (a non-functional update would drop the prefill).
Previously reported (iteration_1) backend auth lockout 500 (naive/aware datetime in auth.py) was NOT retested this round — still open unless fixed.
